question: WeWatch project alternatives / name change
answer:
WeWatch loyihasining nom alternativlari:
• Rave — qisqa, party vibe, allaqachon codebase'da
• Kinova — kino + nova, MDH uchun tushunarli
• Cinepal — cinema + pal (do'st)
• Flickroom — flick + room
• Watchwave — watch + wave
• Syncino — sync + cino

Sabab: 'wewatch' qidiruv tizimida keng tarqalgan (lampochkalar, kompaniyalar, kinoteatrlar).

question: What is WeWatch / Rave?
answer:
WeWatch (Rave) — ijtimoiy onlayn kinoteatr. Do'stlar bilan bir vaqtda film ko'rish, sync, watch party, battle rejimi, gamification.

Tech stack: Node.js + Express + MongoDB + Redis + Socket.io + React Native + Expo.
Status: MVP bosqichi, Railway'da deploy qilingan.

question: How is Obsidian set up for WeWatch?
answer:
WeWatch Obsidian Vault: ~/Documents/weWatch-obsidian/

• WeWatch-Hub.md — Single Source of Truth (sessiya boshida o'qiladi)
• ZONES/ — Instagram, WeWatch-Backend, WeWatch-Mobile, WeWatch-Web, Telegram, AI-Agents
• DAILY/ — kunlik qaydlar
• Skriptlar: obsidian-checkpoint.sh, obsidian-note.sh, memory-load.sh

Claude Code bilan integratsiya: session start/stop hooklar, CLAUDE.md qoidalari, sub-agent spawn'da Hub inline paste qilinadi.

question: WeWatch services / ports?
answer:
WeWatch servislari:
• auth :3001 — JWT, Telegram login
• user :3002 — profil, follow
• content :3003 — filmlar, Elasticsearch
• watch-party :3004 — Socket.io, Redis
• battle :3005 — MongoDB, Redis
• notification :3007 — FCM, Bull, Telegram bot
• admin :3008 — boshqaruv
• admin-ui :5173 — React + Vite

Infra: MongoDB Atlas, Redis 6380, Elasticsearch 9200

question: WeWatch tech stack?
answer:
Backend: Node.js + Express + MongoDB + Redis + Socket.io + Bull + Firebase FCM
Mobile: React Native + TypeScript + Expo
Web: Next.js
Admin UI: React + Vite + Tailwind
